subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in hosted Firecrawl web_search provider now?
rationale: The code path is bounded, but accepting a new public provider id and anonymous hosted search routing is a product/security-boundary choice that prior adjacent maintainer work explicitly left for separate sponsorship.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this external PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if OpenClaw wants to own keyless Firecrawl search later.

options.title: Sponsor Official Provider
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or request a new PR that keeps the current technical shape but records explicit acceptance of the hosted query-routing boundary.

options.title: Narrow To Tool Options Only
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that only expands keyed `firecrawl_search` options and leaves `firecrawl-free` out of official provider metadata.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this external PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if OpenClaw wants to own keyless Firecrawl search later.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the narrowed Firecrawl keyless scrape/fetch implementation and co-owned the adjacent key-free web-search opt-in policy.
